description_en: This three-bayphalcāwas donated by a family of the Avāle caste that lives across the lane. Thephalcāis situated on the street which leads from Balkhu (south) to Cyāsal (north). It is adjacent to the house of Vinaya Avāle's on the western side and to the house of Āśiṣa Avāle on the south. When the house on the south was demolished thephalcālost its wall. Five columns and capitals dating from ca. 1880 have been preserved. Theguṭhīis from the caste of Avāle.
description_ne: यो तीन वटा कवल भएको फल्चा अवाले परिवारले बनाएर दान गरेका हुन् । यस फल्चामा रहेका पाँच वटा काष्ठस्तम्भ १८८० तिर बनेका हुन् । फल्चाको दक्षिणपट्टि रहेको पर्खाल केही समय पहिला मात्र हटाइएको हो । यो फल्चा पश्चिमपट्टि विनय अवालेको घरसँग जोडिएको छ भने दक्षिणपट्टि आशिष अवालेको घरसँग जोडिएको छ । अवाले परिवारले फल्चाको लागि गुठी स्थापना गरेका छन् ।
monument_assessment: Heavily damaged (collapsed, demolished, major cracks and structural damages)

historical_events.event_description: On the occasion of Kājīlāla Avāle'sjaṃkva(thejaṃkvacelebration takes place when a man is 77 years, 7 months and 7 days old), he donated paintings of five Buddhas and of other auspicious signs such as parrots, the eyes of the Buddha, andkalaśasto be placed around the donor statues.
